Below is an honest, criteria-based ranking. We build Leadkaun, so we've put it first and told you exactly where each alternative is the better call.

quickAnswer.question: What is the best lead management software in India?
quickAnswer.answer: For Indian B2B SMBs that want leads graded and prioritised automatically, Leadkaun is the strongest fit — it grades every lead A–F in real time, builds a Priority Queue per rep, and treats WhatsApp as a first-class signal, at flat INR pricing. Zoho CRM suits teams wanting deep customisation, LeadSquared suits high-volume lead-gen, and Zoho Bigin suits micro-teams.

faqs.q: What is lead management software?

faqs.a: Flat per-account pricing (Leadkaun, Kylas) is usually better once you have several reps, because cost doesn't grow with headcount. Per-user pricing (Zoho, Freshsales, Bigin) can be cheaper for very small teams.

The best scoring is transparent, real-time, and decays as leads go cold. Here's an honest ranking on those terms. We build Leadkaun, whose three-score model is designed to be auditable.

quickAnswer.question: What is the best lead scoring software?
quickAnswer.answer: For transparent, real-time scoring, Leadkaun grades every lead A–F across three auditable scores — Fit, Intent, and Quality — in real time, with intent that decays as leads go silent. HubSpot and Salesforce (Einstein) offer predictive AI scoring for larger, marketing-led teams, but their models are less transparent and priced in USD.

criteria: Transparency — can you see and audit the weights, or is it a black box?
Real-time — does the score update the instant a signal arrives?
Decay — does intent fade as a lead goes cold?
Setup effort and who has to maintain the model
Pricing and India fit

picks.watchOut: Overkill and expensive under ~200 reps; opaque to front-line reps.

picks.tagline: AI scoring inside a customisable CRM.
picks.bestFor: Existing Zoho users who want scoring without leaving the suite.
picks.pricingNote: Per user, INR; Zia on higher tiers.
picks.whyPick: Zia adds prediction and scoring to a familiar, customisable CRM.
picks.watchOut: Model transparency is limited; rep adoption of Zoho remains the bigger challenge.

picks.tagline: Built-in AI contact scoring.
picks.bestFor: Teams that want simple scoring inside a clean CRM.
picks.whyPick: Freddy scores contacts automatically with little setup.

faqs.q: What is lead scoring?
faqs.a: Lead scoring ranks leads by how likely they are to convert, so reps work the best ones first. Good scoring is transparent (you can see why), real-time (updates on new signals), and decays as leads go cold.

faqs.q: What's wrong with black-box AI scoring?
faqs.a: If a rep can't see why a lead scored high, they won't trust the number — and they'll go back to gut feel. Transparent scoring (like Leadkaun's three visible scores) is easier to trust, tune, and coach against.

faqs.q: Does lead scoring need a lot of setup?
faqs.a: It varies. Enterprise AI models need data and tuning; Leadkaun ships with weights calibrated for Indian B2B verticals so a graded lead is in the queue within the first hour, and you refine your ICP as you learn what converts.
